noncomputable def VTask.prevFixed {α : Type u} [CompleteLattice α] (f : α →o α) (x : α) (hx : f x ≤ x) : ↑(Function.fixedPoints ⇑f) :=
let g := λ y, f y - y
let gpx := g x
have gx_le_zero : gpx ≤ 0 := by linarith [hx]
have zero_le_g : ∀ y, 0 ≤ g y := by intro y; linarith [hx]
let h := funext gpx
have h' : ∀ y, g y = 0 ↔ y = f y := by intros y; split; simp_all [h]; linarith
let f' : α →o α := OrderHom.ofFun h'
let fp := Function.fixedPoint f' x (by rw h'; linarith [gx_le_zero])
have fp_le_x : fp ≤ x := by rw h'; linarith [zero_le_g]
let fp_fixed : f' fp = fp := by rw h'; linarith [gx_le_zero]
let fp_fixed' : f fp = fp := by rw h'; linarith [gx_le_zero]
⟨fp, fp_fixed'⟩
